result.summary: Fixed delete handler in app.js line 211: remove(null) replaced by remove(li.getAttribute("data-id")). Root cause: placeholder argument left in click handler, so filter(t.id !== null) removed nothing. IDs are strings (randomUUID or base36 string) and li carries data-id from render, same pattern as toggle. node --check app.js passes. Chromium checks not run by this role; parent must record T1/T2 checks against the new product and obtain independent review.

findings.message: Real Chromium checks (T1-T6) and independent review have not yet been run on the new product hash; later stages.
